from itertools import combinations

def is_triangle_free(edges, n=7):
    """Check if a graph is triangle-free."""
    edge_set = set(edges)
    for i, j, k in combinations(range(n), 3):
        if (min(i,j), max(i,j)) in edge_set and \
           (min(j,k), max(j,k)) in edge_set and \
           (min(i,k), max(i,k)) in edge_set:
            return False
    return True

def is_maximal(edges, n=7):
    """Check if a triangle-free graph is maximal (adding any edge creates a triangle)."""
    edge_set = set(edges)
    all_possible = set(combinations(range(n), 2))
    non_edges = all_possible - edge_set
    
    for u, v in non_edges:
        # Check if adding (u, v) creates a triangle
        creates_triangle = False
        for w in range(n):
            if w != u and w != v:
                if (min(u,w), max(u,w)) in edge_set and \
                   (min(v,w), max(v,w)) in edge_set:
                    creates_triangle = True
                    break
        if not creates_triangle:
            return False
    return True
